banner.workspace: Chapter 1 complete. Next: arrange the workspace your way.
banner.plan: Chapter 2 complete. Next: make a plan before anything is built.

comfort_intro.line: Report: Pod 042 will guide you. On any step, Show Me sends this unit to do it for you.

open_chat.line: Proposal: The Chat icon is at the top of the left edge. Show Me can press it for you.

select_teacher.line: Report: Teacher only explains. It cannot change anything.

send_question.line: Proposal: Use the ready-made question below. It is a good question.

answer_stream.wait: Report: Teacher is answering. Stand by.
answer_stream.line: Report: Answer received. It was written in advance, so no AI plan was used.

same_answer_eli5.line: Query: Too many words? Ask for a simpler version.
same_answer_eli5.done: Report: A simpler reply was added. The answer above stayed as it was.

workspace_orientation.line: Report: Scan complete. Pages sit on top, and panels can move.

move_or_dock_chat.line: Proposal: Put Chat where you look most. It can move again any time.

widget_action.line: Proposal: Keep the Approval queue in view. Anything waiting for you shows up there.

open_planning.line: Report: Planning Wizard turns a rough idea into a plan you can check.

book_club_goal.line: Proposal: Practice on a pretend book club website. Nothing will be built.

three_outcomes.line: Report: Three outcomes found. Open one to see what it needs.

access_answer.line: Query: Who should update the site? Any answer is fine here.

review.line: Proposal: Review before anything is built. Changes are easiest now.

review_parts.wait: Report: Reading the plan one part at a time.
review_parts.line: Report: Plan read. Nothing has been built.

answer_edit.line: Query: What changes when an answer changes? Watch the plan.

consequence_changed.line: Report: Only the affected decisions changed. Everything else held still.

completion_boundary.line: Report: Practice complete. Nothing begins until you decide.

pod.missing: Alert: That part is not on screen. Take me there brings it back.
pod.showMe: Report: Demonstrating. Any key or click hands control back to you.
pod.interrupted: Report: Control returned. Carry on whenever you like.
pod.paused: Report: Tour paused. Nothing moves until you resume.
